theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U W K : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → IsCompact K → μ (W \ K) ≠ ∞ → ∀ (L : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (c c' : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ W → (∀ x, |f x| ≤ c) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |ξ x (wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L))| ≤ c') → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ y, |a y| ≤ M) → ∀ φ : TestFormOn U (m + 1), (∀ x, (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = (f x * a (L x)) • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L)) → |T φ| ≤ C * M * ((volume (tsupport a)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) → (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ b : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ b y ∧ b y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ L '' K, b y = 1) ∧ ((volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) (tsupport b)).toReal ≤ δ) → ∀ ζ : TestFormOn U (m + 1), (∀ x, (ζ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = f x • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L)) → |T ζ| ≤ c * c' * (μ (W \ K)).toReal
